newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin gets $1.59 bln contract.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin gets $1.59 bln contract.

text.p: The Lockheed Martin Missiles and Space division of Lockheed Martin Corp has received a $1.59 billion U.S. defense contract for development of a satellite system to detect missile launches, the Air Force said.
The contract is for development and delivery of five geosynchronous satellites with infra-red detection capability and a ground system as well as two special payloads, the Air Force said.
Work on the satellites and other equipment is expected to be completed in the year 2006.
